summary: RptMnuInvoicing is a system module designed to handle invoicing functionalities within the HSPnet application. It includes controls and methods for managing report filters related to invoicing and supports operations like dropdown management, CSV report generation, and filter updates.
purpose: The purpose of RptMnuInvoicing is to facilitate the creation and management of invoicing reports, including the selection of various report parameters and filters for accurate report generation.

workflows.name: RptMnuInvoicing Workflow
steps: Page Load: Initialize session, load controls and saved filters.
PreRender: Set up session-dependent controls and update display properties.
Agency Dropdown: Populate based on session user and mode.
Department Dropdown: Populate based on selected agency.
Program Dropdown: Populate based on selected department.
Term Dropdown: Populate based on selected program.
Type of Placement Dropdown: Manage placement type selections.
Site Chooser: Select sites based on agency.
Run Report: Validate inputs and execute report generation.

business_rules: In receiving mode, RA dropdown contains user's agency only.
Department dropdown includes all departments in receiving mode.
Program dropdown includes all programs in receiving mode.
Report generation requires start and end dates or selection of cohorts/courses.
validations: Ensure start and end dates are provided in date mode.
Check selected cohorts/courses for term mode.
calculations: Header construction based on selected agency, department, program, and term.
conditions: If receiving mode, use date filters.
If termMode is True, use term selection; else use date range.
system_behavior: Updates session filters with user selections.
Generates CSV output based on selected parameters.
dependencies: Dropdown utility functions for managing dropdown selections.
exceptions: Error messages for missing required fields such as start/end date or cohort/course selection.
